cells.quote: The analysis revealed that community nurse training programs improved nurses' knowledge via hybrid pedagogical (SMD = 0.15–2.21), online (SMD = 0.12–0.29) and onsite methods (SMD = −0.51 to 0.11) and enhanced their skills through hybrid (SMD = 0.90) and onsite training (SMD = 0.44).
cells.note: Pooled evidence from six hybrid-training studies within the knowledge analysis; assessment points included immediate post-intervention and follow-up.

cells.quote: The online subgroup showed homogeneity and a small effect size (SMD = 0.21, 95% CI = 0.00, 0.42).
cells.note: The online subgroup comprised one study with four comparisons; the synthesis text describes a small effect.

cells.quote: However, no effects of the onsite subgroup were observed.
cells.note: The onsite subgroup included three studies; the study reports no observed effects rather than an equivalence result.
